sloka: न च राजा गृहं शून्यं प्रविवेश कदाचन ।ततो गृहगतो राजा कैकेयीं पर्यपृच्छत ॥२-१०-१९॥
transliteration: na ca rājā gṛhaṁ śūnyaṁ praviveśa kadācana ।tato gṛhagato rājā kaikeyīṁ paryapṛcchata ॥2-10-19॥

translations.english: Having entered her apartment, the king, unaware of that foolish Kaikeyi's selfish design enquired her whereabouts as usual.
